content.comment_body: I am unable to download; I receive a message saying I am not authorized to access export-restricted software. It instructs me to register for access, which is required for these downloads. The message suggests clicking "Continue to registration" to begin the process.

To download export restricted software, you must complete an extra registration step. Follow the instructions in the message: click "Continue to registration" to start registering. After registering, [company_name] will review your details. If approved, you will receive confirmation and be able to download. This review can take several days, so be patient. For further information, check the FAQ: 'Why is login and registration needed for export-restricted software downloads, and what data is required?'
I am logged in but cannot complete the registration—it keeps showing me the same screen, as shown in the image I attached. Registration does not continue. What should I do?

1.) You need to complete the additional registration step. 2.) Even if you provide all required information, downloading is not immediately available. [company_name] will review your submission first; when approved, you will receive an email confirmation and can then download. You cannot access the download beforehand.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unable to download export-restricted software from [company_name] due to issues with the registration and authorization process. The registration does not progress as expected, leaving the user repeatedly stuck at the same screen. There is uncertainty about how to resolve this and a lack of clear guidance for the registration flow.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a straightforward, functional registration process that enables authorized access and downloading of export-restricted software, without delays or confusing repeated navigation.
